argv:
Customers report that "Load more" loses things. The clearest case: an admin bulk-imported a batch of issues into a project and then paged through the project's issue list a few at a time. The header said how many issues there were, but paging to the end showed far fewer, and some of the imported issues never appeared on any page. The same customer sees it in the notification inbox after a burst of assignments (the list says 7 notifications, the pages show 2) and in the workspace audit log after a bulk change. Lists whose entries were created gradually page correctly; entries go missing only among ones recorded at the same moment.

When you are done, walking any of these lists page by page, with any page size, must return every entry exactly once (nothing skipped, nothing repeated) and in the same order as one large page, and must never include another workspace's entries.

This is a `fix` task: edit the code and stop. Do not write a summary and do not emit an ANSWER line.
